actor: `scripts/plan-check.mjs`, then the reviewer of record on the plan commit
starts: The build lane has pushed the plan commit and the orchestrator sends `PLAN <n> <sha>`.
ends: The reviewer posts `Verdict: plan approved` or `Verdict: plan held` on the draft pull request at that plan commit.

starts: The plan is approved and the orchestrator sends `PLAN-OK <n>`.
ends: The ticket's code sits on the draft pull request's branch, under the size gate, with the plan's tests green.

starts: A build head is pushed and not yet reviewed.
ends: One `chore: de-slop` commit sits on the same branch and the handback gives the new head as the `REVIEW <n> <head>` line.

starts: The orchestrator sends one `REVIEW <n> <head>` line at the de-slopped head.
ends: The review of record is posted at that head with its `Verdict:` line, and the required check follows it.

starts: Every count the pull request needs is in: the verdict, the sessions spent and the checks.
ends: The orchestrator merges, grants one fix pass, or holds the pull request for the owner.

starts: Decide grants one pass against the review of record's `Criterion:` line.
ends: One rebased head carries the fix and its proof under `tests/ci/`, for a fix-head review.

starts: Every pull request in the round is decided.
ends: The round report and ledger are open as one pull request against the orchestration repository.
